category_edits.rationale: For all four category models, reduce causal recency pooling from 0.25 to 0.125 to preserve more immediate intent while retaining recent-history context. Keep decay scale 4, padding normalization, positions, truncation and final-real-position selection unchanged. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so the same readout applies during inference without checkpoint shape changes.

change_summary: Reduce the shared HSTU causal recency-pooling weight to 0.125 for training and generated inference across all four datasets.
